from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile
z=Path('../decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip').resolve()
out=Path('/tmp/jpegs2'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as f:
    for n in f.namelist():
        if n.endswith('.jpg'):
            p=out/Path(n).name
            p.write_bytes(f.read(n))
            r=subprocess.run(['./fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x', str(p)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            print(p.name, r.returncode)
            print(r.stdout.decode('latin1').splitlines()[-5:])
            break
